description: This source file defines an internal class 'AdoNetGrainDirectoryProviderBuilder' that implements 'IProviderBuilder<ISiloBuilder>' to configure ADO.NET based grain directory services in Orleans hosting. It contains logic to set up connection strings and provider options based on configuration data.

classes.name: AdoNetGrainDirectoryProviderBuilder
